Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 在靠墓地的家：在靠近墓地的房子里，A residence verb needs a location phrase with 在, and 靠近 expresses that the house is near the cemetery.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟：带着，When a mother moves together with her child under her care, 带着 expresses that she takes the child along; 跟 does not fit this meaning here.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，另一个 is the standard expression for “another one”; 别一个 is not natural in this noun phrase.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母：孟子和他的母亲孟母，On first mention, introduce the character’s relationship clearly; this tells the reader that 孟母 is Mengzi’s mother.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子：他，For a close re-occurrence, use a pronoun when the referent is clear; the previous sentence has just introduced 孟子.
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 在那个城市：在他们住的城市里，A first mention should not use 那个 when the reader has not yet been told which city it is; use a full noun phrase that identifies the place.
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得她没有钱，For a close re-occurrence of the same character, use a pronoun rather than repeating the name.
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子：他，For a close re-occurrence, use a pronoun because the child has already been identified as 孟子.
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 住了：住，A continuing living situation is a state, so it takes the zero particle rather than completed-action 了.
10. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 祭拜了：祭拜，A daily routine takes the zero particle; 了 is not used for habitual actions.
11. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬了到：搬到了，For a completed movement with the directional/result complement 到, place 了 after 到: 搬到了.

items.reason: 靠墓地 is not the appropriate way to express proximity here; 靠近墓地的房子里 is grammatical.
跟孩子搬家 correctly means that she moved together with the child, so 带着 is only an optional rewording.
别一个城市 is not appropriate for “another city”; 另一个城市 is correct.
On first mention, the teacher requires the relationship of the newly introduced characters to be made clear.
孩子 is vague for the already introduced Mengzi, while 他 can clearly refer back to 孟子 here.
那个城市 has no established city antecedent, whereas 他们住的城市 identifies the place.
Under the teacher's close-reference rule, 她 should replace the immediately repeated name 孟母.
孩子 is vague, but after the intervening information the teacher's rule calls for 孟子 again rather than 他.
住 describes an ongoing living state here, so it should not take perfective 了.
每天 marks a habitual action, for which 祭拜 should not take 了.
With the directional complement 到, 了 must follow the complement: 搬到了.
